item.text:
`npm run weather` failed because [weather.js](/private/tmp/envtest.T09HSc/shop-api/src/weather.js) called `api.weather.invalid`, which cannot resolve. I switched it to a working Open-Meteo endpoint for Tallinn and added response checks.

I reran `npm run weather`; it now exits successfully and prints current weather data. This repository contains no widget code, so I could verify the script’s output but not the widget display.
